name: Business Bocchi-chan
original_name: ビジネスボッチちゃん
source:
A junior at the part-time job where Fashion Komyushou-kun works. She has a cheerful personality and is very friendly.

She always considers the atmosphere of the place first, and tries to fit in with others whenever she can.

[translated from [url=https://3on10.com/fashion/]official site[/url]]
